hotels.title: Perth Golf Escape 25-Minutes from CBD with Daily Breakfast & 27-Hole Championship Golf Course
hotels.description: Nestled in natural bushland just 25 minutes north of Perth CBD, Joondalup Resort is Western Australia's premier golf and leisure destination. Here, guests can play a world-class round of golf, relax by the lagoon-style pool and indulge with restorative treatments at Endota Spa - all without ever leaving the property. At the heart of the resort is a championship 27-hole golf course, designed by internationally renowned architect Robert Trent Jones Jr. Three distinct nine-hole layouts deliver their own dramatic character, from rugged limestone outcrops and shimmering water hazards to sweeping bushland fairways. Whether you're a seasoned low-handicapper or simply love the game, Joondalup is always a rewarding course. Beyond the hotel, explore the surrounding coastline, visit Yellagonga Regional Park or take a short drive to Hillarys Boat Harbour for dining, boating, and family-friendly attractions. With Perth CBD just a short drive away, everything you need is within reach.
